title: Instantaneous CO 2 emission modelling for a Euro 6 start-stop vehicle based on portable emission measurement system data and artificial intelligence methods.
summary: Linear regression, random forest and gradient boosting predict measured CO2 emissions from velocity, acceleration and road gradient; a single Euro 6 start-stop car was driven twice over 111 km (>3,000 one-second records), with 80/20 train/test and MSE/R2/plots. Narrow result only; no population or regulation-wide inference.
